name: Marble sculpture
material: carved stone, typically marble; crystalline/translucent behavior depends on stone and finish
visible_production_marks: chisel/rasp traces may survive in unfinished or recessed zones
polished high points contrast with tooth/abrasion texture
small chips follow brittle stone fracture
edge_behavior: Edges range from crisp carved ridges to softened polished transitions; thin unsupported projections are risky and often require supports.
mark_making: chisel/rasp traces may survive in unfinished or recessed zones
polished high points contrast with tooth/abrasion texture
small chips follow brittle stone fracture
color_behavior: Base stone is not automatically pure white; ancient polychromy is possible and must be chosen by era/state rather than erased by a “white marble” stereotype.
surface_behavior: Crystalline stone, subtle subsurface light at thin edges, matte-to-polished variation; never waxy skin.
composition_behavior: Design around gravity, support points, stone block continuity and 360-degree silhouette for statues; busts need intentional truncation/support.
structural_limitations: no impossible floating strands or paper-thin unsupported fingers
deep undercuts limited by fracture risk
surface detail must remain carved into stone rather than painted photoreal skin
aging_weathering: aged marble may show softened edges, mineral staining, small chips, weathering or loss
museum-conserved state should be cleaner/stabilized and not uniformly dirty

prompt_fragments.core: Translate flesh, hair and cloth into carved stone masses: readable planar transitions, intentional chisel-to-polish hierarchy, weight-bearing support and stone-continuous details.
prompt_fragments.artifact: Make the object visibly fabricated from one or joined stone masses; define base, truncation or backing plane rather than leaving a floating human-shaped render.

evaluation_criteria: reads as stone before it reads as a filtered person
support and mass are physically plausible

sources.supports: Greek marble quarrying, picks/chisels/drills, polishing and painted surfaces

scope_note: This module controls material/production behavior. It does not select an era by itself.
